newsitem.title: UK: CBI says rate rise won't curb UK demand growth.
newsitem.headline: CBI says rate rise won't curb UK demand growth.

text.p: A quarter-point rise in British interest rates is unlikely to restrain growth in domestic demand and had been largely factored in by industry, the Confederation of British Industry said on Tuesday. "We are looking for growth in demand...a quarter-point rise is unlikely to knock that on the head," Sudhir Junankar, associate director of economic analysis at the CBI, told reporters.
Earlier, the Bank of England signalled a quarter-point rise in base rates to 6.25 percent at the request of new Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown.
